title: Composition of the degree-zero etale restriction comparison
statement: For a commutative ring A, etale maps p:T→U, v:U→S, w:T→S and an equality w=p≫v, and any sheaf P of A-modules on S_et, the derived compositor at single(P), followed by p-pullback of etaleSingleRestrictionIso A v at P and etaleSingleRestrictionIso A p at v-restriction of P, equals etaleSingleRestrictionIso A w at P followed by singleFunctor of localizationRestrictionComp prime at P. All comparison maps are the actual maps of [lem-amb-etale-degree-zero-hom].

source.place: Overlap calculation: inverse image and the degree-zero Hom correspondence commute with restriction

proof.text: Use [lem-amb-etale-single-restriction-factors] to express the actual comparison as two factors. Expand the degree-zero restriction comparison into the single-degree derived-pullback comparison and the singleFunctor image of upperStarIsoLocalizationRestriction. Naturality moves the latter through the comparison for p. Apply leftDerivedUpperStarComp_hom_app_singleFunctor to the first three factors. Combine the sheaf maps with functoriality and apply upperStarIsoLocalizationRestriction_comp from source EtaleMorphismDescent. The abstract comparison helper proves this categorical algebra once and is specialized to the actual functors.

theorem etaleSingleRestrictionIso_comp (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A]
    {T U S : Scheme.{u}} (p : T ⟶ U) (v : U ⟶ S) (w : T ⟶ S)
    [Etale p] [Etale v] [Etale w] (hw : w = p ≫ v)
    (P : Sheaf S.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)) :
    (leftDerivedUpperStarComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) p v w hw).hom.app
        ((_root_.DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj P) ≫
      (ordinaryFinitePullback A p).map ((etaleSingleRestrictionIso A v).hom.app P) ≫
      (etaleSingleRestrictionIso A p).hom.app
        ((localizationRestriction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) v inferInstance).obj P) =
    (etaleSingleRestrictionIso A w).hom.app P ≫
      (_root_.DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).map
        ((localizationRestrictionComp' (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) p v w hw).hom.app P)
